# RTM Travel — Remmitz Travel Management

> Premium corporate travel management company (TMC) for South African businesses. ASATA and IATA accredited. Serving CFOs, executives, and finance teams since 2008.

RTM Travel (Remmitz Travel Management) is a B2B Travel Management Company based in South Africa. We specialise in corporate travel management, duty of care compliance, expense management, and executive travel services. We are BEE Level 1, 100% female-owned, and operate in association with eTravel.

## What We Do

- Corporate travel booking and management (flights, accommodation, car hire)
- Duty of care compliance and 24/7 traveller support
- Corporate travel policy enforcement and spend reporting
- Executive VIP travel and event coordination
- Incentive travel programmes

## Who We Serve

South African businesses of all sizes — SMEs, mid-market, and large corporates — with domestic and international travel requirements. Our primary clients are CFOs, finance managers, executive assistants, and operations leads.

## Accreditations

- ASATA (Association of Southern African Travel Agents) accredited
- IATA (International Air Transport Association) accredited
- BEE Level 1 — 100% Female-Owned Enterprise
- In association with eTravel
